authority: Durable release-level exit contract for the whole corpus. It supersedes any reading of current-input computational exhaustion as corpus completion.
completionDefinition: The corpus is complete only as a dated saturation claim under a declared search protocol: every generated physics-mathematics adjacency is dispositioned, every terminal branch has had its nearest reopening neighbourhood swept, every experiment has executable build/bridge/physics decision gates and outcome propagation, and the theory, literature, implication, narrative, retrieval, provenance and reproducible-release gates all pass together.
nonClaims: Completion does not mean that nature or mathematics has no unknown structure.
A zero corpus-ready finite-task count is an intermediate stopping condition, not corpus completion.
Graph centrality, PageRank, retrieval rank and document count are navigation evidence, not scientific truth.
An external blocker counts as a classified frontier only after its searched neighbourhood, exact missing datum and reopening trigger are recorded.

gates.name: Physics-mathematics adjacency saturation
gates.exit: Every in-scope object or normalized topic has been crossed with every applicable adjacency family; every generated candidate has exactly one typed disposition, evidence receipt, consequence and reopening trigger; an independent verifier finds no missing or multiply classified edge.
gates.missingArtifact: None for EXIT-01 under the declared adjacency protocol. The normalized topic layer dispositions all 542 candidates across 53 topics. The independently verified object expansion inventories 3,254 objects, types 1,553 exclusions, maps all 1,701 in-scope scientific objects into 55,279 object-topic-family claims, and leaves zero unmapped objects, zero disposition conflicts and zero weak semantic routes. There are 378 explicitly reviewed routes alongside 1,323 strong title routes, including the observer/horizon, nuclear, Leech spectral/device, Maxwell curl-quotient, programme-algebra governance, bulk-cone and Becker--Yang spectral-type objects. Regeneration automatically reopens this gate if any unresolved route or structural conflict appears.

gates.name: Exhausted-end neighbourhood saturation
gates.exit: Every closed, killed, blocked or exhausted branch has a terminal certificate covering all required neighbourhood moves, inherited downstream consequences and the minimal datum that would reopen it.
gates.missingArtifact: None for the current terminal universe: all 80 checks across ten closed or blocked topics have evidence, findings, inherited consequences and exact reopening data. Regeneration automatically reopens EXIT-02 if another terminal topic appears.

gates.name: Experimental programme closure
gates.exit: Every experimentally reachable topic has a realistic programme containing every required field and all three decision layers; every outcome updates named claims and topics; every programme has an executable verifier or an explicit external readiness gate.
gates.missingArtifact: None for EXIT-03: all 22 canonical programmes and all 396 required cells are explicit, including build, bridge and physics decisions, replication, release and claim propagation. The focused TH229/Kerr register adds two public-data programmes and ten exhaustively propagated outcome branches without claiming a corpus-specific bridge. Corpus completion remains forbidden while any other exit gate is open.

gates.name: Theory and mathematics closure
gates.exit: Every theoretical bridge records types, units, assumptions, maps, preserved and lost structure, invariants, limits, counterexamples, equivalence freedom, physical non-implications and an independent verification route; genuine open problems are separated from finite missing work.
gates.missingArtifact: None for EXIT-04 under the declared bridge grain. The verified audit covers all 481 distinct topic-by-relation-family bridge clusters and therefore all 55,279 object-family cells. Every cluster records source and target types, unit treatment, assumptions, map, preserved and lost structure, invariants, limits, a counterexample or kill test, equivalence freedom, physical non-implications, an independent verification route and a reopening trigger. Authored topic-level work classes separate 145 finite experimental/engineering, 32 finite theory/computation, 163 dependency-gated finite and 18 audit clusters from 27 external-data, 12 external-theory-breakthrough and 12 genuine-open-problem clusters; 72 are resolved within scope.

gates.name: Literature-frontier saturation
gates.exit: Every major branch has a dated reproducible search receipt containing databases, queries and synonyms, backward and forward citation searches, neighbouring disciplines, strongest support and opposition, present bounds, conflicts and the precise residual novelty claim.
gates.missingArtifact: None under the dated 25 October 2026 search protocol. All 22 maintained frontier targets have a verified receipt containing databases, exact queries, synonyms, backward and forward citation searches, neighbouring disciplines, strongest primary support and opposition, present bounds, conflicts, a defeasible negative-search result, bounded residual novelty and an update trigger. The register explicitly forbids treating a negative search as proof of nonexistence and records adverse results including EP-excluding chiral transfer, phonon-drag alternatives, detector rank without global injectivity, scheme dependence and the absence of independent validation for recent mass-gap proof claims.

gates.name: Claim implication and defeat closure
gates.exit: Every authoritative claim states why it has its exact form, what it implies and does not imply, what defeats it, which assumptions support it and which downstream claims change under each outcome; propagation is machine-auditable.
gates.missingArtifact: None under the declared claim-graph protocol. Reopens if a canonical claim lacks exact-form, assumption, consequence, non-implication, defeat or propagation coverage, or if an unobserved reference is promoted into an implication edge.

gates.name: Standalone narrative closure
gates.exit: Authoritative standalone routes preserve Jordan admission, Lie transport and the typed realizability middle; introduce things before names; explain reasons, nearest alternatives, pictures, open/closed status and implications; and quarantine optional speculation, myth and theology without sterilizing practical hope.
gates.missingArtifact: None under the declared standalone-route audit. Reopens if a route loses things-first explanation, the Jordan–typed-middle–Lie balance, reason/status/implication boundaries, practical look-here work, or science-before-speculation order.

gates.name: Documentation, linking and retrieval closure
gates.exit: No authoritative object is orphaned or ambiguously governed; all internal links, generated surfaces, hashes and provenance are current; duplicate and contradiction audits pass; held-out retrieval works across mathematics, physics, experiment and ordinary language; centrality is explicitly non-authoritative and minority/new branches remain discoverable.
gates.missingArtifact: None under the declared mechanical and retrieval protocol. All 16 governed roots are typed and present; every inventoried object is classified; root-closure and claim links have no missing targets; canonical claim identities have no working-copy divergence; the one legacy identifier collision is explicitly dispositioned; exact-hash and normalized-title conflict candidates are exhausted; 30 governed benchmark cases pass at MRR 0.925; and twelve additional held-out routes remain discoverable in 36 zero/default/maximum-centrality runs. Cross-wording semantic contradiction remains an EXIT-09 adversarial responsibility rather than being falsely claimed solved by lexical machinery.

gates.name: Adversarial reproducible release
gates.exit: A frozen clean checkout regenerates every derived artifact, passes all tests and verifiers, survives independent overclaim/type-change and random provenance audits, records external blockers and reopening triggers, and emits a dated release certificate whose corpus identity matches every included receipt.
gates.missingArtifact: None under the dated release protocol. A deterministic 32-claim provenance sample, six authored cross-wording conflict reviews, four fail-closed mutations and two complete external-blocker contracts pass. The release orchestrator requires a clean checkout, regenerates all declared derived surfaces, runs every frontier verifier and all repository tests, rejects any tracked diff and emits a commit-, tree- and projection-bound receipt. The certificate uses an explicitly declared non-self-referential projection and reopens on any included-file change or qualifying new evidence.
